subQuests.subQuestName: Talk to the Raiden Shogun within the Plane of Euthymia
Talk to the Raiden Shogun within the Plane of Euthymia

20200301.text: Indulge my curiosity. What is the reason that I find you standing here before me once again?

20200302.text: Do you hope your foolhardiness will shelter those people? Or... was it simply a means of seeking an audience with me?

20200305.text: Oh? Surely you didn't rouse me from my state of eternal meditation only to tell me this?

20200306.text: If so, then you underestimate me. I am quite well-informed about the Vision Hunt Decree.

20200307.text: You know everything that's going on outside?

20200308.text: Not so. Only everything that pertains to eternity.

20200309.text: The Vision Hunt Decree has my tacit approval.

20200310.text: The Fatui's actions thus far do not constitute a threat to eternity, otherwise... they would have been purged long ago.

20200504.text: Why can you not trust your people, and in the power of their ambitions?

20200505.text: These ambitions have transcended space and time. They are something that no one can snuff out.

20200509.text: Is this the lesson you learned from your journey in Liyue?

20200511.text: There are nations where humans cast their god aside and stride forward...?

20200512.text: So, are we to just abandon the notion of progress... for the sake of wishful thinking?

20200513.text: ...You and I have both witnessed the great loss that progress can bring.

20200514.text: Eternity... eternity is the only way...

20200515.text: The Heavenly Principles... Irrelevant nonsense as far as I am concerned.

20200516.text: When all's said and done, all you really want is to protect your beloved Inazuma, forever and ever. Isn't that right?

20200517.text: That would be something of an oversimplification.

20200518.text: But is this nation worth existing for eternity?

20200519.text: Stripped of ambitions, stripped of the potential for change, it does nothing more than simply... exist. It is a hollow shell of a nation.

20200520.text: Huh. I wonder what loss would it really be to anyone if such a nation were destroyed?

20200522.text: Never-changing eternity is the promise I made to my people.

20200523.text: But what your people need from you is not your promises. They want your attention... your divine gaze.

20200525.text: Humans have a lifespan of barely a hundred years. They cannot afford to bear any extra losses.

20200526.text: But I have experienced it all. That is why I have chosen to guide them along the correct path toward eternity.

20200528.text: But eternity is far too cruel a fate for you, Ei.

20200530.text: Not only have you stopped paying attention to the world, but you have stopped paying attention to yourself.

20200531.text: It must have been terribly lonely here, all alone, for centuries on end.

20200533.text: You will miss much by refusing progress... You seek to prevent loss, but have you considered all you are losing by remaining here in stasis for all eternity?

20200534.text: You are obviously lonely, and yet for the sake of eternity you choose to stretch your loneliness out to infinity...

20200535.text: Tell me this. Why is the sky here that was once so dark glowing again? Why now?

20200536.text: This is your Plane of Euthymia. It's your inner world.

20200537.text: So it can only mean... that you are happy to see me again. You have found the loneliness here unbearable for a long time now, haven't you?

20200538.text: I... have nothing to say to that.

20200539.text: Hehehe, oh, but I have so much to say to you. Let me tell you all that has happened over the last few centuries.

20200541.text: As a fox envoy, I have an excellent memory. I recall every detail of the last few centuries with perfect clarity.

20200542.text: So it will probably take me another few centuries to relay it to you.

20200543.text: Heh... hehe... Miko, I never thought I would have the chance to meet with you like this again.

20200544.text: *sigh* Seeing you again is a change to eternity... and a very nice surprise.

20200545.text: Hehe, since you are willing to admit that, I suppose that means we can still be friends?

20200546.text: What a childish conversation this is.

20200547.text: Anyway. Now that I have been defeated by you and your plan, I will honor your wish to abolish the Vision Hunt Decree.

20200548.text: But with regards to eternity and the question of whether this nation should move forward, I need time to give it some thought.

20200549.text: Hehe, you are the one who's been acting like a child from the very beginning.

20210101.text: So what did you guys do in the Raiden Shogun's Plane of Euthymia anyway?

20210102.text: Is the Vision Hunt Decree abolished?

20210105.text: Oh, gotcha... Paimon was super worried, y'know.

20210106.text: So maybe the reason Yae Miko is looking for us now is 'cause she wants to thank us? Let's go find her.

400972101.text: #Oh, hey there, {NICKNAME}. Nice to see ya!

400972102.text: Didn't expect to see you here at this hour, Dehya.

400972103.text: Hahaha, well, Cyno's out of the country on a trip, so he got me to come and help his subordinates take care of a few things. I guess you could say I'm his temporary substitute.

400972104.text: The atmosphere around here's not too bad nowadays, so I don't mind sticking around once in a while.

400972105.text: You've probably got a lot going on yourself, I'll bet? Good luck with everything!

400972201.text: Setaria, you should take a break and have a bite to eat.

400972203.text: Ah, thank you! Sorry, I was completely absorbed in what I was doing, I didn't even hear your voice...

400972204.text: It's alright. I'm glad that you enjoy the work you're doing.

400972205.text: Sorry you've ended up having to babysit me... I'm sure you have far more important things to do.

400972206.text: Well, Rahman's busy with the Eremites these days. But having me stand in as your bodyguard must be a welcome breath of fresh air for you?

400972207.text: It's a change for me, too — my first time working as a bodyguard. I'm just treating it as a chance to get a taste of Dehya's line of work.

400972208.text: I tried telling Mahamatra Cyno that I can work unsupervised. Really, this ought to be the last of his worries...

400972209.text: He said that educators willing to work in the desert are an extremely rare breed, so I need a bodyguard for protection at all times... I think he's being a little overprotective.

400972210.text: But at the end of the day, that's why we know we can count on the General Mahamatra. He and I are of the same mind in this case, so I am very happy to protect you.

400972211.text: While you're in Aaru Village, we're partners. We don't want to cause you any unnecessary pressure. So please, try to enjoy your time here.

400972301.text: Whoa, did you two see that? A bird with huuuge wings just flew by!

400972302.text: If Master Tighnari was here, he'd be able to tell you its scientific name, species, and behaviors...

400972303.text: But as for me... all I can tell you is, it isn't a species we have in Sumeru...

400972304.text: Oh? Then what kinds of birds do you have in Sumeru?

400972305.text: Dusk Birds! They have the most beautiful, vibrant colors. The feathers on their chest are the color of ripe Sunsettias, and their wing-tips are the color of tender Mint leaves.

400972306.text: They're not too skittish around people, and at my tree holl— I mean, this tree that I often go past, there's a Dusk Bird there that always looks at me like it understands what I'm saying.

400972307.text: I once picked up one of its feathers from the ground, and it felt really nice...

400972308.text: You have keen observation skills, and a love for living things. You'd be better served directing your energies there rather than sighing and whining all the time.

400972309.text: Ugh, Eula says things in the most awkward way possible sometimes... Just ignore the second half, Collei!

400972310.text: No, it's fine, I know what she means. She does have a point...

400972311.text: Are you hungry for fish? I see quite a few over there.

400972312.text: Sounds like someone's up for a fishing contest, huh? Fair warning, though, I won't lose!

400972313.text: Seriously...? Another competition? I thought we were supposed to be sightseeing. ...Uh, but still — wait for me!

400972402.text: ...From which direction will Stormterror appear, I wonder?

400972405.text: Ah, sorry, sorry, I didn't mean to disturb you.

400972406.text: I apologize as well. I acted on force of habit. You must be a local, yes? My name is Cyno, and I'm here sightseeing in Mondstadt. In truth, it is I who am disturbing you.

400972407.text: Um, might I ask if you're looking for something here?

400972408.text: I'm waiting for Stormterror to arrive.

400972409.text: You even set up a Kamera...

400972410.text: Yes. I hope to capture a good picture as reference material for an artist I know.

400972411.text: Ah... In that case, let me help keep watch too. From what I've heard, Stormterror's movements have some... regular schedule.

400972412.text: Roughly how often does it appear?

400972413.text: Uh, hold on. I'll have to check against our data first. Let me consult my notes...

400972416.text: Um... Mr. Cyno, Sir, are you going to stand there staring into the sky the entire time?

400972417.text: Don't worry, I'm quite strong. My neck can take it.

400972418.text: No, no, I mean... You should sit down. I—I brought a blanket — here, you can borrow it!

400972421.text: ...Weird. Now I'm staring up into the sky, too...

400972501.text: I've heard that Cecilias only grow in remote spots at high-altitude, and that you're unlikely to ever see one unless you go looking for it.

400972502.text: Though they can be preserved for a long time as specimens, I can't take back the beauty they possess in the wild. It's a shame.

400972503.text: Shall I ask Sucrose to develop a Cecilia variant with improved soil adaptability for you?

400972504.text: I should warn you, though, it may very well end up with a name like "Tetratanic Ananemo Cecilia," or perhaps "Epsilon-Series Cecilia, Variation 601, Sumeru Growth-Type."

400972505.text: ...Is this you attempting to tell a joke?

400972506.text: Unfortunately not. I'm being completely serious.

400972507.text: In that case, I look forward to... well, whichever of those two it ends up being.

400972508.text: Back to our previous topic — if you wish to use antitoxic compounds from Calla Lilies in an antidote, then I have a few suggestions...

400975101.text: I wonder who will have the honor of offering the Windblume to Lord Barbatos this year?

400975102.text: Ah, I'm so envious. If only I could be the one.

400975103.text: (If I had to pick a flower to give away, which one should I choose? Agh, what a dilemma...)

400975104.text: (Let me think of this a different way. If... If I want to find the flower that fits Master Diluc the most...)

400975105.text: (Gosh... Now all I can think about is Diluc...)

400975201.text: Welcome to Mondstadt — make sure you don't miss out on the Windblume Festival!

400975202.text: The Windblume Festival has its origins in Old Mondstadt, and the legend of the Windblume carries still to this day.

400975203.text: Even now, most Mondstadters believe that the Windblume Festival is a festival for lovers and that they should express their love with the most extravagant sincerity during this time.

400975204.text: Of course, there are also the more traditional amongst the Mondstadters who think that the key purpose behind the Windblume Festival is to celebrate Mondstadt's liberation. For them, this festival is more suited toward remembrance than love.

400975205.text: I believe that both these perspectives are fine. Everyone should get to choose the way they wish to celebrate.

400975206.text: I hope that everyone can find their own joy during this Windblume Festival, including you! Happy Windblume Festival, friend!

400975301.text: Oh, Traveler. As you can see, the Windblume Festival's come around again.

400975302.text: Every festival, there are plenty of youngsters that like to go out and adventure in the wilds.

400975303.text: Ah, what can I say. I'm old. I know what these kids are thinking better than they do.

400975304.text: To me, the Windblume Festival represents the continuation of the rebelliousness passed down by the resisting heroes from the era of the Stormlord of the Tower.

400975305.text: But... I suppose I can't expect the younger generation to think like me, right? Haha!

400975306.text: Well, if the youngsters can feel the charm of adventuring through the spirit of the festival, I suppose it's worth it.

400975401.text: ...*sigh* Traveler, what kind of gift do you think moves people the most?

400975402.text: Windblumes... I'm sure Barbara-sama has already seen plenty of those and won't be interested at all.

400975403.text: A letter... I think Barbara-sama gets plenty of those as well, and the feedback from her fans is virtually the same.

400975404.text: I need to get her something more unique, something more eye-catching...

400975405.text: Huh, you mean we need to be careful not to cause any trouble for Barbara-sama? Ah, right, thanks for the reminder. That's really important too.

400975406.text: Barbara-sama's work is essential. As fans, we should do our utmost not to disturb her!

400975501.text: Huh? I recognize this voice... Traveler?

400975502.text: The Windblume festivities are in full swing! If you get time, do make sure to roam around. You'll find a very different Mondstadt.

400975503.text: Even better, if there's someone important to you, you should spend the festival with them. That's where the Windblume spirit truly resides...

400975504.text: The Windblume Festival is a celebration of comfort and warmth. If possible, I wish I could spend this time with my beloved, Godwin...

400975505.text: I still don't know how he's getting on... May the winds protect him.

400975601.text: So, just what kind of flower was the Windblume from Old Mondstadt?

400975602.text: Modern Mondstadters have every opinion in the world about Windblumes, but they all seem to lack the desire to seek out tangible proof.

400975603.text: It might be that the atmosphere of this festival is too leisurely. I'm seeing wandering couples play at being adventurers without properly understanding what a real adventure is.

400975604.text: Hmph, I'm not like them. As a true scholar, I want to discover the truth behind the question, and won't be deterred by anything else!

400975605.text: Speaking of which, Mr. Doolan often tells me that we should go to Cape Oath to have a look. What a curious idea. It's not as if there are ruins there or anything...

400975701.text: Angel's Share is a great place to bring a date!

400975702.text: There's no need to trek all the way up to Starsnatch Cliff, nor is there a point in climbing the heights of Cape Oath. All you need to do is walk into a tavern, order two drinks, and chat the day away with your companions!

400975703.text: Apple cider, cherry cider... and delicious Dandelion Wine. If you want it, the Angel's Share's got it.

400975704.text: This is, after all, an industry thriving beneath the gaze of our esteemed Master Diluc. All beverages are supplied straight from the Dawn Winery.

400975705.text: So, how about it? Want to come in?

400975801.text: Greetings, the Knights of Favonius are at your service.

400975802.text: Blessings of the Anemo Archon upon you. On this romantic festival, I bid you and your companions joy and cheer.

400975901.text: Hi, is there something you wanted my help with?

400975902.text: If it's not urgent, please pardon me for not keeping you company.

400975903.text: I did have to slip out, after all. I want to get my wife something special.

400975904.text: ...And some wine while I'm at it. Ah, how can you be a Mondstadter if you don't get to drink, especially on a holiday?

400975905.text: As for what kind of gift I should get her... well, I suppose I'll figure it out on the way to buy some wine.

400976001.text: Hello, are you here to buy something as well? Huh, you aren't?

400976002.text: *sigh* I envy people like you who can show restraint when shopping...

400976003.text: Especially during a holiday with special sales and discounts everywhere. I even find the wine very tempting...

400976004.text: Ah, no. I must control myself. Resist, Eury! If I get any wine, why, it'll only end up being consumed by my alcoholic of a husband!

400976101.text: Huh. Am I seeing things, or was that the General Mahamatra I just saw walking around Mondstadt...

400976102.text: ...I must be seeing things. The General Mahamatra is always busy. How's he supposed to find the time to wander around Mondstadt!

400976103.text: Must be because I've been reading too much lately, triggering flashbacks to all the nerve-wracking research I had to do at the Akademiya...

400976201.text: Oh, did the wondrous fragrance of my cooked meat draw another? Hehehe.

400976202.text: You can really tell it's the holidays when the streets are full in this little town. Even outlanders have come to visit.

400976203.text: I thought he was here to ask for directions, but instead he surprised me when he inquired if I knew how to make any dishes using Philanemo Mushrooms.

400976204.text: Cooking with Philanemo Mushrooms... isn't impossible. But at most, they just accent the meat.

400976301.text: Hmm, instead of celebrating the festival in the city, you're out here in the wilderness adventuring...

400976302.text: Are you, perchance, also searching for the Windblume?

400976303.text: As far as I'm aware, "Windblume" was possibly once a code word for people who wished to stay in contact and plot resistance in secret...

400976304.text: But with the changing of the times, the relational understanding between the people and the idea of the Windblume has also shifted.

400976305.text: In this modern age of peace and freedom, beyond just the Mondstadters, the peoples of other nations might instill a new significance into the Windblume Festival.

400976306.text: If such is the case then, the very meaning behind the Windblume itself will likely be varied in expression.

400976401.text: "A flower that is not of this world"... Could that be referring to the real Windblume?

400976402.text: Ah, I'm sorry, I was preoccupied with thinking about something.

400976403.text: An adorable child bought a storybook from me, but I remember there being a rather strange riddle within its pages.

400976404.text: It might've been something that someone just accidentally left behind. You don't need to pay any special heed to it.

400976501.text: I'm being serious, there really are heart-shaped Sunsettias around Cape Oath...

400976502.text: Bea, your eyes must have been playing tricks on you. Sunsettias just don't grow into that shape. It's against the laws of nature.

400976503.text: And even if they did exist, there's no way that they could be sweeter than the ones I'm already selling.

400976504.text: Well, why don't we just go over to Cape Oath to have a look? It won't take long...

400976505.text: No. This has to do with my convictions! Using visual attraction to sell fruit is just a cheap trick. I would never do that.

400976506.text: ...Oh come on, why won't you just get it already...

400976507.text: Sorry? What did you just say?

400976508.text: *cough* Uh, nothing... Come on, just consider it for a second!

400976601.text: Even if she's a close friend, my resolve won't be shaken... *hic*

400976703.text: That's right. I'm Quinn of Quinn's Fruits. My booth is at...

400976704.text: Fresh fruits only at... Quinn's Fruits...

400976804.text: Ever since the Windblume Festival began, she's been bugging me about Cape Oath and heart-shaped Sunsettias...

400976805.text: Sunsettias of that kind just don't exist...

400977001.text: Well, by the looks of you, I'd say you're an adventurer! Not going to stock up on some new equipment during the Windblume Festival?

400977101.text: What do you have for sale?

400977102.text: Take your pick from this selection. All Master's own handiwork, so you won't find any second-rate items here.

400977201.text: About the Windblume Festival and adventurers...

400977202.text: A lot of couples will choose to have dates at Cape Oath, but there are some brave adventurer couples who will venture near Stormterror's Lair.

400977203.text: That area is simply crawling with monsters, so many adventurers will come here to purchase new equipment...

400977204.text: ...After all, if you were to be beaten by monsters in that place, you wouldn't just lose face — you'd be putting your companion in danger, too...

400977205.text: So each time the Windblume Festival rolls around, we smiths run brisker business than usual, so I suppose we can be thankful for that.

400977302.text: Take care, and make sure to enjoy the Windblume Festival!

400977401.text: Welcome to Floral Whisper. Are you looking to get someone a bouquet? It's the Windblume Festival, after all.

400977501.text: I'd like to buy some flowers.

400977502.text: Certainly. We have a fine selection, whether you're looking to give a bouquet to someone or even do some gardening yourself.

400977602.text: The Windblume Festival is an ancient tradition of Mondstadt's. A day for freedom and romance.

400977603.text: When we speak of Windblume Festival tradition, I suppose it's about giving the "Windblume" in your heart to the person who's the most important to you, hehe.

400977604.text: As to what flower the Windblume actually is, everyone's got their own opinions.

400977605.text: Well, that's freedom for you, hehe.

400977702.text: I hope you'll enjoy yourself during the Windblume festivities.

400977801.text: Marla, the Windblume Festival is here, and yet, it holds no meaning for me...

400977803.text: We do not have your father's approval, but this time for lovers is ours also...

400977804.text: No, what I mean is that as long as I am with you, every day may as well be the Windblume Festival.

400977805.text: You're right, Marvin. Our love is like the dandelions that bloom on Cape Oath...

400977806.text: Marla, no... Our love should not be a thing so fragile...

400977807.text: No, I mean to say that though the dandelions are scattered by the wild winds, their lives will not thusly end.

400977808.text: Dandelion Seeds will fly to distant places, take root, and sprout there... One day, they will cover the length and breadth of Teyvat.

400977901.text: Since it's the Windblume Festival, would you like to come to The Cat's Tail and have a few drinks?

400977902.text: I might even give you some flowers... Hehe.

400978002.text: The Windblume Festival had a very solemn meaning once...

400978003.text: But nowadays, many people believe that it's just a time when they send flowers to others and get their feelings across.

400978004.text: Oh? Have someone you'd like to send flowers to, do you? Let me guess... is it me, by any chance?

400978005.text: ...Haha, don't be so nervous. I was just joking.

400978201.text: #Hey there, {M#amigo}{F#amiga}! Are you here to listen to Six-Fingered José's latest composition?

400978202.text: Hehe, fear not. My creations do not disappoint.

400978203.text: When it comes to the Windblume Festival, other bards think of love songs. Madre mía, no sense of invention...

400978204.text: I, Six-Fingered José, on the other hand, am not constrained by convention. I wish to eulogize the heroic epics of ages past! The people must remember that this is a day for commemorating heroes and resisting tyrants!

400978205.text: Even if, ahem... I haven't quite finished the last part yet. But once it's complete, it will bring my audience running back!

400978301.text: This is the time of the Windblume Festival, the season when dandelions float about in the wind.

400978302.text: I've always been looking forward to a time when I might express my love for my destined one amid a sea of billowing dandelions...

400978303.text: But I never expected Miss Patchi to be too absorbed in her research to understand a thing I was saying...

400978304.text: Nothing could be more boring than spending such a romantic festival buried knee-deep in books and ruins.

400978305.text: Who knows how long it'll take for her to understand these deep yet nebulous feelings of mine...

400978401.text: *sigh* I wonder how Glory is doing...

400978402.text: I wish I could return to Mondstadt to see her... But I can't. How can I let her know that her lover is a coward and a deserter?

400978403.text: The best I can do now is clear out monsters and do my part to protect Mondstadt... and her.

400978404.text: Laugh if you want. I'm... I'm a useless man.

400978501.text: The Windblume Festival... Hmph, it's that time of the year again, is it?

400978502.text: I had an epiphany when I got divorced, and it was like waking from a long dream: the Windblume Festival should never have been associated with love at all!

400978503.text: Hah, it must have been the scheme of some scheming city merchants. Wouldn't they love to package every festival as something for lovers?

400978504.text: ...People in love have no rational thought to speak of. A little flattery here and there and their wallets open wide.

400978505.text: Whatever the case, I've come to my senses now. These festivals are absolutely meaningless.

400978506.text: ...And if not for the Windblume Festival, would I even have met that man? Hmph...

400978601.text: Foxes really are too difficult to catch. Just how exactly did the elders manage it...

400978702.text: Oh! As Springvale hunters, this is one of our customs.

400978703.text: Every Windblume Festival, young hunters like me go to Wolvendom to catch foxes.

400978704.text: When we catch one, we place a wreath of flowers on its head and release it. It's a prayer for finding love in the year ahead...

400978705.text: Of course, only eligible young hunters like myself participate. Hunters that have already tied the knot, like Draff for example, they're not allowed to take part.

400978707.text: *sigh* Not even close. Foxes are so hard to catch.

400978708.text: I didn't catch one last Windblume Festival either. In fact, I nearly injured myself. I remember swearing that this time would be different...

400978709.text: ...and yet, low and behold, I've been outfoxed again. All I caught were a couple of squirrels.

400978710.text: That said... I wonder if Miss Sucrose could use her bio-alchemy to change squirrels into foxes?

400978713.text: Uh... if you always participate, your chances will increase exponentially...

400978714.text: ...in that sense, you're bound to bump into the right person eventually...

400978715.text: ...ahem. Anyway, that's what Draff's always telling us.

400982101.text: Why, if it isn't my underclassman, Cyno. What a pleasant surprise it is to see you in Mondstadt during the Windblume Festival.

400982102.text: Greetings, Lisa. Though I'm sure you've been aware of my presence in Mondstadt for some time already.

400982103.text: Oh dear, looks like you've seen right through me. But I was in no hurry. I knew we'd see each other sooner or later.

400982104.text: Yes. It's just as Professor Cyrus said — shared aspirations always have a way of bringing people into each other's orbit.

400982105.text: Hehe, he always has such a poetic way of wording things. I suppose that's the one respect in which I've taken after him, while in your case...

400982106.text: Yes, it's his wit and eccentricities that have left their mark on you.

400982107.text: Hmm. I'm not sure that describes me very aptly these days, given that I'm now the General Mahamatra. Still, if we're going to talk about ways with words, I think my deadpan humor is far superior than our professor's.

400982108.text: Is that so? Strange, I heard that you're just Cyno the Adventurer when you're in Mondstadt.

400982110.text: What do you think of Mondstadt during this time of year? It's quite nice, isn't it?

400982111.text: Yes. It's very nice. I think I'm starting to understand your reasons for leaving the Akademiya.

400982112.text: Hehe. I've always prided myself on making wise decisions, and that was certainly one of them.

400982113.text: If our professor had been as sensible as you, he would have had a much easier time in his working life. Being stubborn doesn't help anybody.

400982114.text: Well, if even you feel comfortable criticizing him now that he's retired... it really goes to show how much he's changed.

400982115.text: Stubbornness is an all-too-common vice among scholars. I hope that never rubs off on you. I'm always happy to see you visit Mondstadt, and experience the feeling of freedom for yourself.

400982116.text: I heard the latest news about Collei, too. No doubt the traumas of her childhood will persist for a while to come, but I have to say, she appears to be doing quite better this time than on previous visits.

400982117.text: I suppose you're something of a mentor to her, aren't you? Now that I think about it, the two of you aren't so dissimilar. The power of Hermanubis once brought you great suffering.

400982118.text: That's all in the past now. Besides, Professor thankfully didn't treat me like a test subject for the priest's power like the higher-ups had hoped, even though I was a desert-dweller.

400982119.text: Instead, he gave me the tools I needed to lead the life I have today. He adopted me, educated me, taught me how to fit into society... I am very grateful to him.

400982120.text: You are very gifted, and sometimes that can become its own curse. But he has reason to be grateful to you, too — without you as his son-slash-student, he may never have changed his stubborn ways.

400982121.text: As a fellow student of his, I couldn't be happier for the two of you. ...Ah, look at how quickly this developed from small talk to a deep and serious conversation. That's one thing I do miss about my Akademiya days.

400982122.text: By virtue of being another of his students, you are as much a part of professor's family as I. It's perfectly natural for a daughter to inherit her father's conversation style.

400982123.text: If you say so... I suppose that means I get to call you "baby brother" from now on.

400982125.text: Hahaha, yes, there's the baby brother I remember.

400992101.text: Am I... Am I dreaming? Miss Ying'er, you really came all the way to Mondstadt to see me...

400992102.text: Wh—Why were you willing to make the trip? I still can't believe it...

400992103.text: Hehe, why wouldn't I want to come see you, hmm? It's not like a quick trip from Liyue to Mondstadt is completely unheard-of or anything.

400992104.text: Also, isn't it time for you to drop the "Miss," and just call me Ying'er?

400992107.text: Ying'er... Heh, I... I think I still need some time to get used to calling you that...

400992108.text: Hehe, look at you, already so flustered. And we're just getting started!

400992110.text: I'm just overwhelmed with happiness. Thank you so, so much for coming to see me for Windblume...

400992201.text: You liked the card back from Cyno, right? I must admit, I also spent a good amount of effort coming up with the design.

400992202.text: His request was quite interesting. He wanted a dragon, a cool pose, and a design that would stand out and awe his opponents.

400992203.text: Although the commission was for himself, he wanted the back to be flashy enough to draw the attention of the opposing player. Perhaps, there's something that can be said about how when it comes to Genius Invokation TCG, friendship is more important than competition.

400992204.text: He also said that such an impressive card back should be shared with friends. Since he gave it to you, this must mean he considers you to be a close friend.

400992205.text: Oh, and speaking of, to repay my efforts, he also gifted me the card back as well. Hmm... maybe I'll also give the game a try.

400992301.text: Collei! Sucrose! I brought some home-cooked food, why don't we enjoy it together?

400992303.text: I—I must point out a small issue about your cooking! You have a tendency to put a little too much flavoring in your dishes...

400992304.text: Ahahaha, sorry! I guess I've been a little heavy-handed with the seasonings lately...

400992305.text: Are you feeling stressed recently? Do you want to find someone to play cards with? It really helps with stress, I promise!

400992306.text: Oh, that sounds like a good idea. If I recall, both you and Sucrose are pretty good players, right?

400992307.text: Oh yeah, we are! We've been playing together, and we were actually talking about this just a few days ago...

400992308.text: Since you are already familiar... would you mind also showing me the rules sometime?

400992309.text: Yeah, Collei seems to be a natural at the game... Maybe she's already the best player out of all of us!

400992311.text: That's right, you've been all the talk at the tavern. "That little girl from Sumeru is really good at the game... If I can find the chance, I would love to test my skills against her."

400992313.text: Isn't that great, Collei? You've become a TCG celebrity!

400992401.text: Mona, look! I found a four-leaf clover. It's so pretty; do you like it?

400992402.text: Huh? Is it for me? Thank you, Klee!

400992403.text: Um, could you also say something nice to Klee?

400992404.text: Oh, of course! Ahem. I've actually gotten really good at this! Hmm...

400992405.text: O Miss Klee, our mighty Spark Knight, you are the flame of hope for all of Mondstadt, and the vessel for...

400992407.text: Oh no, Klee doesn't seem to really appreciate this kind of praise. Okay, then...

400992408.text: Klee, you're super adorable, and your hat and backpack are the cutest! Did your mom get them for you?

400992409.text: Yep! Mom said that she picked them out with Dodoco, and Dodoco really loves this backpack, too! Which is why Dodoco's always hanging from the side!

400992410.text: Mom also said that someone else was also helping her pick out the gifts that day... Hmm, what was the name again...?

400992411.text: Ah, if Klee remembers correctly, people would call her... the old hag.

400992412.text: Wait, the old hag!? ...Huh, okay, now that you mention it, the old hag does have a fondness for picking out hats...

400992501.text: Thank you so much for your surveying tips! I had no idea that the Sumeru Forest Watchers would also have expertise in this area... You really do know just about everything!

400992502.text: It's only natural that Forest Watchers and surveyors would have some similar skills. We're both constantly outdoors and on the move, after all.

400992503.text: Anyway, I'm glad I could help.

400992504.text: If I can find the chance, I'd love to pay a visit to Sumeru as well! I've heard that the terrain is quite complicated there, and it'd be a treat to see it for myself.

400992505.text: Yes, "complicated" is indeed one way to put it. Visitors often get lost when they visit Sumeru for the first time, and they have a tendency to pick all kinds of mushrooms and fruits in the rainforest without discretion.

400992506.text: Ah, we get a lot of people here picking Philanemo Mushrooms as well...

400992507.text: Actually, have you ever tried adding them to a recipe? They are quite bland by themselves, but perhaps, the taste can be improved if they're cooked together with other ingredients...

400992508.text: I've never tried that myself... But now that you mention it, I do want to give it a try...

400992509.text: I'm quite curious, too. Would you like to pick some together later?

400992601.text: Well, what do you think? I trust you've enjoyed this year's Windblume Festival?

400992602.text: I'm happy to see you find the time amidst your busy adventures to return to Mondstadt and celebrate the winds of freedom with us.

400992603.text: And if you have a moment now, would you care to hear a new love poem I wrote this year?

400992604.text: Ahem! Allow me to recite it for you.

400992605.text: This world has never seen such vibrant color / it bestows upon everyone a brilliant hue

400992606.text: A shade more ethereal than white / yet more radiant still than gold / it eases into your eyes / and restores to light a solitary soul

400992607.text: Hmm... maybe a bit too somber? Maybe I should write another one on Sweet Flowers instead...

400992701.text: Do you have time for a duel?

400992702.text: I'm sorry, I don't know how to play.

400992703.text: Huh, really... I suppose you've been too busy with other things to pick up the game?

400992704.text: I'd suggest you visit The Cat's Tail. There's a teacher there who's quite proficient with introducing beginners to the game. You can learn the basics from her.

400992705.text: The sooner you learn, the sooner we can duel.

400992801.text: I quite like my new card back. It goes perfectly with my deck.

400992802.text: I take it that you've also received your card back? Want to use it to play a round?

400992804.text: I need to familiarize myself more with the deck and the rules...

400992805.text: No problem. Just come find me again when you're ready.

400992807.text: You played well. Let's have a rematch in a few minutes.

400993302.text: Hi there, are you also interested in alchemy?

705280301.text: What do you think? Care to have a game of Floral Chess?

705280304.text: The adventurer who designed this game said that his inspiration came from the billowing petals and the wind that pursues them...

705280305.text: And the game is meant to imitate the... romanticism of pursuing these flower petals...

705280306.text: From a player's perspective, though, I'd say it's more like being chased around by some balloons with flower petals and paper strips stuffed in them...

705280307.text: The experience isn't bad, don't get me wrong, but where's the romanticism...?

705280309.text: Yeah, see you. If you wanna give this a try, just come over and give me a shout.

705280701.text: Is this game really that romantic? I don't feel it at all...

705280702.text: Or maybe I just utterly lack artistic talent... or something...

705290301.text: Would you like to play a song? As long as you do your best to keep up with the rhythm and beat, you'll be able to strum up a storm with ease.

705290302.text: Focus only on the wind around you and the lovely song you wish to play, and all your troubles will surely fade away.

705290304.text: No problem. The scores are over here and ready for your perusal.

705290306.text: Oh, that's fine... You're welcome back any time, though!

705290601.text: Ah, I hope this event will go smoothly this time too...

705290603.text: I'm preparing to welcome guests here. We've got all sorts of fun activities lined up for the Windblume Festival.

705290604.text: But some of the events are being held outside the city due to the large areas needed, so without a guide to tell people where things are happening, some of them are going to miss out!

705290605.text: That's why I've been stationed here and put in charge of introducing the festival's activities to everyone.

705290608.text: There are three events taking place during the festival: "Ballads of Breeze," "Floral Pursuit," and "Breezy Snapshots."

705290609.text: The activity I'm in charge of, specifically, is "Ballads of Breeze." The other two representatives should also be at their stations and making some final preparations.

705290610.text: Everyone's pretty excited, so here's to the smooth running of this year's Windblume Festival.

705290611.text: May you have a happy time as well!

705300301.text: The photo-taking is in your capable hands, Traveler!

705300302.text: If we can call this a job well done, Cyrus should be more inclined to approve our request to set up a Kamera Club.

705300303.text: And as long as we can set it up, we should be able to attract more Kamera enthusiasts and further refine the art of taking pictures!

705300304.text: Perhaps we might even be able to invite hobbyists from other nations...

705300305.text: W—Well, would you look at that? I'm getting rather ahead of myself, aren't I? Focus, man, focus — focus on the work at hand.

705300701.text: My Kamera's in pretty good shape.

705300702.text: C'mon, Fassben, you can do this — think about the Kamera Club!
